performers.asset: KayKit_Mystery_Series6/1 - July 2024 - Combat Mech · Textur alt
performers.role: der Koloss, in dem eine ganze Stadt arbeitet

residentHome: Kanzel eines riesigen Mechs, Rohre, Rohrpost, Bordsprechanlage
structure: resident monologue in the cockpit: the colossus discovers the levers are painted on; the departments report over the intercom as the animals from their card art; the owls' memo is the turn
synopsis: A spoken-word number from a card deck that describes the human body as a city. It is performed by a giant walking machine in its own cockpit, for whoever happens to be there.
bestOfReason: Hook 1-2: the city runs itself, the citizen was never asked.
Departments 5, 7, 9, 10, 28: organs report as their card-art animals.
Alarm 11, 15, 18, 17, 19: memory, copy errors, the competitor, friendly fire.
Archive 21, 23, 24, 30: looking beats the book; the institution rejects the finding.
Perception 26: the brain draws in what it cannot see (open-address joke).
Turn 6: the owls' memo - press secretary, not president.
Landing 32: the body is the score.

omitted.3: machine-vs-body thesis carried by the mech frame itself
omitted.8: second filter joke after the liver
omitted.12: slow broadcast overlaps the intercom device
omitted.13: energy motor breaks the department rhythm

orderReason: Brain card 6 moved to the turn; Night Shift 28 closes the departments; alarm block ordered DNA -> Cancer -> Inflammation -> Autoimmune; Blind Eye 26 placed after the archive as the open-address joke.

songLineChanges.songLine: The decision was already underway five hundred milliseconds before you made it.
The Lungs: seventy square meters folded into your chest.
Eighty percent of the phone calls go up to the brain.

cues.cue: intercom crackle, then the drum kit from the boiler room

beats: Somebody climbed into my cockpit again. Or nobody did, and I am talking to my own pipes. Either way, keep your hands off the levers. They are painted on.
I am a colossus, a whole metropolis on two legs. I walk, I fight, I hold very still for statues. I have not once decided anything.

beats.text: The City Inside has been running the civilization while you were busy with other things.
The Citizen: you never once told this city what to do. It never once asked your permission.

beats: The intercom crackles. The departments report whether I ask or not.

beats.pre: Cardiac, down in the boiler room, a badger on a drum kit:
beats.text: The Heart: the brain can modify the rate. The brain cannot generate it. The badger drums alone.

beats.pre: Deck two, two broccoli trees trading birds:
beats.text: The Lungs: seventy square meters folded into your chest, the only manual override.
beats.post: That one I get to touch. In. Out. Mine.

beats.pre: A grim beaver at the oil drums, does not look up:
beats.text: The Liver: Prometheus was anatomically correct. It's the only organ that grows back.

beats.pre: The subway, full of commuters who do not get off:
beats.text: The Gut: eighty percent of the phone calls go up to the brain. The subway runs the city.

beats.pre: At night the mice come out with mops.
beats.text: The Night Shift: sleep is the janitorial shift washing the thoughts out of the carpet.

beats: Then the sirens. The rats in riot gear take the intercom.

beats.text: The Immune System: a library of every murder attempt. It remembers things you have forgotten.

beats.pre: The spider in the copy room answers for the typos:
beats.text: DNA Replication: one error per billion letters; you have had cancer, the spider usually eats it.

beats.pre: Then a voice from the shoreline, a crab with a fortress on its back:
beats.text: Cancer: evolution occurring inside you. It is not a disease; it is a competitor.
Inflammation: the response that heals the wound becomes the mechanism that burns the city.

beats.pre: The dog in the corner bites his tail.
beats.text: Autoimmune: the discrimination fails, not the weapon. The gun works fine, pointed the wrong way.

beats: In the archive, old voices argue about who drew my blueprints.

beats.pre: A mole in a ruff, stomping on a textbook:
beats.text: Andreas Vesalius looked at the body instead of the book. Everyone else was wrong.

beats.pre: A raccoon washing his hands while the shadows laugh:
beats.text: Ignaz Semmelweis saved the mothers. The doctors committed him. He died of the infection.

beats.pre: And the barn door with the big sign on it:
beats.text: The Semmelweis Problem: evidence available, implication uncomfortable, we reject the finding.

beats.pre: The tortoise with four potions still thinks he built me.
beats.text: The Humoralist: wrong in the facts, right in the vibe. It was the first Kayfabe.
The Blind Eye: you have a hole in your vision. The brain fills it in with best guesses.
beats.post: So if nobody is really standing there, I have painted you in.

beats.pre: Last report, from the owls upstairs in their judge wigs:
beats.text: The Brain: the decision was already underway five hundred milliseconds before you made it.
You are the press secretary, not the president.

beats: Half a second. When I hold still for a statue, somebody else already picked the pose.

beats.text: The Scorekeeper: the body keeps the score because the body is the score.

beats: Every colossus in every square thinks it is marching. Most of us are being marched by a badger with a drum.
So whoever climbed in: leave the levers. Listen to the drum.
